transcript: AGENT: Hi, thanks for calling MultiTracks Playback support. I'm an AI assistant. What can I help you with today?
CALLER: Hi, I added waymaker to our set list but there's no tracks option. It only shows click and guide
AGENT: Hmm. Okay. I'll check on that for you.

AGENT: That usually means Way Maker was added from the catalog, which can provide Click and Guide without the multitracks. Could you tell me the six-digit Organization ID shown in Playback Settings under About, so I can check your team's access to that song?
CALLER: Sure. Our organization ID is four eight zero one one three

AGENT: It looks like Way Maker isn't in your organization's library, so Playback can load only its click and guide. The tracks would need to be purchased. Would you like me to connect you with someone who can help with that?
CALLER: Oh, so we never actually bought it. Okay, I'll get our admin to purchase it. Thanks. Bye
AGENT: 'kay. Thanks for calling MultiTracks Support.
